desc:
🎵 DANCE AVENUE 🎵
An Audition-style rhythm dance game! Hit the arrows, then press SPACE on the beat 💃🕺

🎶 118 songs, Thai and international
👥 Dance battles with up to 5 players per room, or play with bots
🔥 4 difficulties: EASY / NORMAL / HARD / EXPERT
✨ 370+ dance moves that get flashier as the level rises
💫 Earn coins and unlock glowing hand auras
🏆 Climb the weekly leaderboard
📱 Works on PC and mobile

⭐ VIP: gold name + exclusive Red Blue Infinity aura + 5% bonus EXP and coins

How to play: walk into a room gate ➜ pick a song ➜ press Start and dance!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new songs every update
